NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs the patched app under its own package name and launcher name, so it can be installed next to the official YouTube Kids app and is never replaced by its updates.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name of the patched app. Must differ from the official app.

options.title: App name
options.description: Name of the patched app in the launcher. Leave empty to keep the original name.

patches.name: Channel allow-list
patches.description: Only shows and plays videos from channels a parent has allowed. Adds an "Allow this channel" button and an "Allowed channels" settings entry, both protected by the app's parental gate.
